name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused exclusively on gold assets in Nevada, one of the world's top-rated mining jurisdictions. Operating with low overhead, the company builds a diversified portfolio of precious metal royalties and land positions by partnering with operators across several of Nevada's highest-grade historical mining districts. Nevada Canyon is in the development stage, growing its royalty portfolio rather than operating mines directly.
